summary.text: Derek Slap has represented Connecticut's 5th Senate District since 2019, after winning a February 26, 2019 special election, and is the Democratic candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

paragraphs.text: He previously represented the 19th District in the Connecticut House from 2017 to 2019.
He earned an M.B.A. from the UConn School of Business and bachelor's degrees in broadcast journalism and international relations from Syracuse University.
He was a news anchor and reporter at NBC Connecticut from 1999 to 2004 and has worked as Director of Communications for Senate Democrats.
